name: Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹30,000/- or 75% of the actual expenditure (whichever is lower).
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be up to 45 years of age at the time of application. 1. The applicant should have participated in or completed a training program, workshop, expedition, or competition related to land, sea, or air adventure sports.
